text: Deferred Python-only last-wins recall recovery: 100-F/FF7DE872 fails closed (drops the direct edge) on same-file duplicate top-level defs to guarantee no wrong-target edge. For Python, where the last def legally shadows earlier ones, a future enhancement could recover recall by minting the edge to the effective (last) definition instead of failing closed. Documented v1 non-goal in docs/architecture.md 'Same-file duplicate-name resolution (FF7DE872)'.

Daemon 'engram index' cross-file singleton not persisted + CLI response hang: on a fresh git workspace, plain 'engram index' via the daemon leaves cross-file singleton calls edges (e.g. alpha->beta) staged/unresolved and the 'engram index' CLI hangs on response while the daemon completes server-side. Root cause suspected at src/cli/direct.rs:162 (use_index = full || force) routing plain index to the sync path, which skips the cross-file post-pass (reresolve_calls_edges_with_canonical_context). Pre-existing, NOT caused by 100-F (18/18 recall + cross-file tests GREEN via in-process index_workspace). Investigate index-vs-sync routing + IPC response completion. See docs/compound/workflow-issues/new-extraction-logic-needs-forced-reindex-2026-07-20.md.

Orphan direct-edge sweep: one-time GC of code-graph calls_edge rows whose from/to has no live function_meta (legacy already-orphaned same-file direct edges re-minted by a pre-101-F ordinary sync), gated into the --revalidate-code-graph certify path before advancing code_graph_extraction_generation. Non-traversable so no wrong query answers, but raw-row hygiene for full H4 literal compliance. Source: Copilot PR #293 cozo_queries.rs:2119.

Forced-index deletion reconciliation: index_workspace only walks discovered files and lacks the incremental sync path's deleted/excluded-file reconciliation, so a previously-indexed file newly EXCLUDED (still on disk) keeps its stale same-file direct edge while the generation marker advances (deleted-file case self-heals via the next incremental sync deletion phase). Reconcile the prior file set before certifying the marker on the forced-index route. Source: Copilot PR #293 code_graph.rs:1900.

Daemon startup pending-sync drain hardening: hydration cancel / DB-connect-failure exits (lifecycle.rs) call finish_indexing WITHOUT drain_pending_sync; the coalesced drain runs once and does not loop; sticky pending_sync + companion gate bits (revalidate/backfill_python) can outlive a queued request and leak into a later routine sync. Make every lock-release path drain or atomically clear all companion state, or loop-drain until no pending request remains; add cancellation/failure regression test. Source: Copilot PR #293 write.rs:288 / lifecycle.rs:403.

Stage harvest-provenance reconciliation: declined Copilot base-diff comments on .backlogit/archive/stash.jsonl (8DD29746 promoted to 101-F, F97D51DF to 102-F) archived with generic reason:archived, dropping the harvest link. Stage-owned bookkeeping to preserve promotion provenance on stash archival. Source: Copilot PR #293 stash.jsonl:130-131 (same decline as inline comment #8).
